source.stem: The diagram shows a quadrilateral on a 1 cm² grid.

parts.text: Write down the mathematical name of this quadrilateral. [1]
Work out the area of this quadrilateral. Give the units of your answer. [3]

intelligence.enrichment: The area of a compound region can be found by adding areas of non-overlapping simpler parts or by subtracting an inner area from an outer area.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_08/ch_207. The student must decide: Decide how to find the area of a compound region by decomposing it into computable parts or subtracting one region from another. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
